integrity: The original numerical iteration and prior nonacceleration examples are credited. The exact quantitative frontier and unique optimum are the assessed claim. Finite symbolic/numeric verification is distinct from the proof; no independent scientific validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Identity system, Gaussian rank-one fresh sketches, fixed nonnegative momentum, zero initial velocity, unaveraged mean-square Euclidean error, exact arithmetic. No general-system or large-minibatch claim.
title: Exact mean-square frontier and a sharp no-momentum optimum for Gaussian heavy-ball Kaczmarz
